thread:
ken: Noticing a big regression on console metric panes after last deploy. US canary LCP jumped 3.8s -> 7.1s when opening project dashboards with multiple sparklines.

maria: Same here. Flamegraphs show long main-thread parse + long eval spikes. Network shows main.bundle.js gz ~1.05MB now (was ~720KB).

sam: Any suspects? We touched chunking config in the webpack upgrade PR. Also saw a change where `date-utils/locale/en` was imported in a shared util which used to be dynamically required.

jing: We also changed `kv-affinity` routing rules for a small A/B test last week to prefer EU caches for some users. Could be increasing cold reads from origin if the cache warm ratio differs per region.

ken: Repro: open Dashboard > Metrics > expand all sparklines (10 series). CPU profiler shows parse+compile peaks at ~450ms each due to a new polyfill pulled by `date-utils/locale/en`. It drags in `@format/intl` and `intl-pluralrules`.

maria: So two things compounding: 1) main bundle grew because a formerly async locale got accidentally imported in shared-utils, 2) routing changes increased origin hits for that payload, causing re-parses more often.

sam: Quick mitigation options:
- revert the webpack/chunking change that materialized the shared chunk (canary rollback)
- patch shared-utils to use `await import('date-utils/locale/en')` so locale remains async
- temporarily revert kv-affinity tweak to restore previous cache hit ratio

jing: I can flip the routing flag back for the affected cohort; it's a config toggle in infra console.

ken: @deploy-bot can we rollback canary d-2026-08-14? We need to validate if main bundle size drop restores LCP.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback for canary d-2026-08-14 queued. ETA ~6m.

maria: After rollback, canary LCP back to ~4.0s. Bundle gz down to ~730KB. Confirmed.

sam: I'll open two PRs: 1) safe lazy-load of locales in shared-utils + unit test ensuring locales are chunked; 2) CI perf guard asserting main bundle gz < 800KB. Also will add a bundling guideline to the repo README about not importing locale/polyfill modules into sync entrypoints.

jing: I'll run the routing A/B with telemetry to collect cache-hit metrics across regions and share results in the ticket.

ken: Good. Also let's add a quick smoke check in release pipeline that opens Dashboard with 10 sparklines in headless Chrome to catch regressions before canary.

maria: Agreed. Thanks team. Moving follow-ups to eng-platform backlog: PRs from @sam, routing audit from @jing, and bundling guideline RFC. :white_check_mark:
